learnings.question: Economist Herbert Simon warned in 1971 that an information-rich world creates a scarcity of what?
learnings.learning: Herbert Simon observed in 1971 that in an information-rich world, the abundance of information creates a scarcity of attention — the resource it consumes.
learnings.articleTitle: Everybody wants your attention, but not everything deserves it.

learnings.question: In Surah Al-Mu'minoon, what Arabic term refers to the 'ill speech' — drama, gossip, and meaningless talk — that successful believers are described as turning away from?
learnings.learning: Surah Al-Mu'minoon describes successful believers as those who turn away from 'Lagw' — ill speech such as drama, gossip, and meaningless talk.
learnings.articleTitle: Everybody wants your attention, but not everything deserves it.

learnings.question: Which 19th-century psychologist demonstrated that people forget about 80% of what they learn within 24 hours unless they actively recall it?
learnings.learning: In the 1880s, Hermann Ebbinghaus showed that without active recall, we forget about 80% of what we learn within just 24 hours.
learnings.articleTitle: Is Your Brain the Worst Place to Store Ideas? Why I Built a Second One

learnings.question: What term do researchers behind the 'Google Effect' paper use to describe our brains' habit of deleting information once it's written down or saved digitally?
learnings.learning: Researchers behind the 'Google Effect' paper coined the term 'Digital Amnesia' to describe how our brains stop retaining information once it's offloaded to a device.
learnings.articleTitle: Is Your Brain the Worst Place to Store Ideas? Why I Built a Second One

learnings.question: In Scrum, which artifact represents the team's committed list of user stories selected for the current Sprint?
learnings.learning: The Sprint Backlog is the Scrum artifact representing the team's committed list of user stories selected for the current Sprint.

learnings.question: What is the main purpose of breaking a project into the smaller, iterative cycles called Sprints in Scrum?
options: To allow for more flexibility and quicker adjustments
To increase the overall length of the project
To reduce the number of team members needed
To eliminate the need for a Product Owner
learnings.learning: Scrum breaks projects into short, iterative cycles called Sprints mainly to allow for more flexibility and quicker adjustments.

learnings.question: In Islamic teaching, what term describes awareness of Allah's presence that builds self-restraint and purifies one's intentions?
learnings.learning: Taqwa is the mindfulness and awareness of Allah's presence that builds self-restraint and purifies one's intentions.

learnings.question: In Islamic teaching, human existence centers on which three primary roles?
options: Seeking wealth, raising a family, and building a legacy
Gaining knowledge, serving the community, and achieving personal success
Worshiping Allah, serving as stewards (khalifah) of the Earth, and preparing for the Hereafter through accountability
Following tradition, respecting elders, and preserving culture
learnings.learning: Human existence is framed around three roles: worshiping Allah, serving as khalifah (steward) of the Earth, and living out a test of faith and accountability in preparation for the Hereafter.

learnings.question: In PCIe power management, which state is the deepest power-saving substate within L1, powering down the most components at the cost of the longest wake-up delay?
learnings.learning: Within PCIe's L1 power state, L1.2 is the deepest substate, powering down the most components for maximum energy savings at the cost of the longest wake-up delay.
learnings.articleTitle: Power Management States in the context of PCIe

learnings.question: In Islamic theology, what term refers to Allah's complete, eternal, and already-written plan encompassing all events, as distinct from their actual unfolding?
learnings.learning: Qadr is Allah's complete, eternal, and already-written plan encompassing every event, as distinct from Qada', the actual unfolding of those events.
learnings.articleTitle: The Art of Qada’ and Qadr

learnings.question: Per a hadith in Jami at-Tirmidhi (3573), when does Allah withhold granting a sincere Dua made by a Muslim?
options: Only if the person has unpaid debts
Only during the last third of the night
Only when the supplication is for something sinful, or for severing family ties
Only when fasting is broken intentionally
learnings.learning: A hadith in Jami at-Tirmidhi (3573) states that Allah grants every sincere supplication unless it asks for something sinful or for severing family ties.
learnings.articleTitle: The Art of Qada’ and Qadr

learnings.question: An analysis of the Quran's text found there are approximately how many Arabic words for every one word in the Oxford English Dictionary?
learnings.learning: There are roughly 12 million distinct Arabic words against about 170,000 in the Oxford English Dictionary — an approximate 71:1 ratio.
learnings.articleTitle: Top 20 Words to Understand the Quran: A Data Analysis using Python

learnings.question: When testing whether the Pareto Principle (80/20 rule) applies to word frequency in the Quran, what percentage of the total text did the top 20 most frequent words actually account for?
learnings.learning: Testing the Pareto Principle against Quranic word frequency showed the top 20 most-repeated words make up only about 20.83% of the text, not 80%.
learnings.articleTitle: Top 20 Words to Understand the Quran: A Data Analysis using Python

learnings.question: After a Malaysian outlet featured his halal food-finder app, how many unique visitors did the owner report it had received in its first month?
learnings.learning: After a Malaysian outlet (Siakap Keli) featured the owner's halal food-finder app, it had attracted over 9,000 unique visitors within its first month.

learnings.question: What field of study did the owner abandon after two years of high school biology and a few months into matriculation college, before enrolling in Computer Engineering at UTP instead?
learnings.learning: The owner walked away from a path toward medicine after two years of biology in high school and a few months into matriculation college, choosing Computer Engineering at UTP instead.
